play.headline:
Keep the important things
in sight.
play.caption: Every reminder waits for your confirmation.
play.alt: Enjoy Dark Current view with plants, puppy, and a part-completed morning checklist.

play.headline:
Swipe it away?
It comes back.
play.caption: Reminders return until you confirm they're done.
play.alt: Real Android notification shade, in dark mode, with four distinct synthetic reminders and the plant reminder's Done and Snooze actions expanded.

play.headline:
Ignore it too long,
it escalates.
play.caption: Unconfirmed reminders can become a ringing alarm.
play.alt: Real Android escalated alarm, in dark mode, for the synthetic Check the oven reminder, with native Done, Snooze, and De-escalate controls.

play.headline:
Finish the task.
Then mark it done.
play.caption: Checklists, notes, and controls in one clear view.
play.alt: Enjoy Dark reading dialog with a morning checklist and Done and Snooze controls below it.

play.headline:
Make room for
your daily routines.
play.caption: Medication reminders with names and doses.
play.alt: Synthetic vitamin D reminder editor in Enjoy Dark with a 1000 IU dose.

play.headline:
Share the reminder.
Stay on the same page.
play.caption: Plan together, or assign a task to one person.
play.alt: Enjoy Dark sharing dialog with a staged synthetic recipient, Alex.

play.headline:
A place for the things
you want to keep.
play.caption: Notes and checklists, without an alarm.
play.alt: Enjoy Dark Notes view showing a trip-packing checklist.

play.headline:
Know when
it is done.
play.caption: See progress on tasks you have assigned.
play.alt: Enjoy Dark Assigned by me view with synthetic parcel pickup completion.
